name: 「Mahoroba」 SPECIAL ~Ningen Isu History~
original_name: 「まほろば」SPECIAL〜人間椅子ヒストリー〜
overview: 【“Mahoroba” SPECIAL ~Ningen Isu History~】 A special program for Ningen Isu, releasing their 24th album “Mahoroba” on Wednesday, November 19th, airs! Featuring Maple Chogokin's Natsu Ando, a huge Ningen Isu fan, as MC, we revisit the band's 36-year journey with ultra-rare footage from their early days, unearthed from Space Shower's archives. Plus, we'll dive deep into the appeal of their new album “Mahoroba” for an intense 30 minutes!
